_meta.purpose: Tier list for Phase-0 re-bench targeting 16GB-RAM CPU machines.

harness_caveats: TTFT p50/p95 are inflated by daemon model-swap overhead — multiple Ollama-resident models (qwen3.6:23GB, qwen3-coder:18GB) caused forced eviction during the run. Use the per-model best-1 TTFT (warm-cache) below as the realistic value.
Peak RAM column sums RSS across every ollama-named process, so it counts other models still resident in keep_alive. The ram_min column in the SQLite is closer to single-model footprint.

verdict.primary_local_4b: qwen3.5-4b — quality 8.12 in 2.6GB Apache-2.0 footprint. Quality gap to gemma4-e4b is 0.33pt (4%) but disk is 3.7× smaller and license is permissive.
verdict.api_quality_target: qwen3.5-9b — quality 8.36, but 21s warm TTFT even on M4 Max means it's not viable locally. Use as the cloud/API quality ceiling.

rejected.qwen3-4b-instruct-2507: Superseded by qwen3.5-4b (-0.40pt quality at the same size).
rejected.llm-jp-3-3.7b-instruct: JP-specialised but ranks last on quality (6.56). 1.56pt below qwen3.5-4b — no use case left.
rejected.gemma4-*-as-primary: Disk 7.2-9.6GB on Ollama (PLE+audio_encoder bundled) is too heavy for the 16GB-RAM target. Kept only as legacy fallback for users who already pulled it.

qwen3.5-4b.rationale: Rank 1. Speed-vs-quality balance, daily-driver candidate. 16GB CPU: TTFT 1-3s, ~6-10 tok/s typical.

qwen3.5-9b.rationale: Rank 2. Quality benchmark target ('本命'). On 16GB CPU expect TTFT 5-10s and tok/s ~1-3 — bench numbers will decide whether the quality lift is worth the wait. NOT in the daily-driver candidate set; bench-only.

qwen3-4b-instruct-2507.rationale: Rank 3. Previous-generation 4B Instruct. Kept for direct A/B against qwen3.5-4b — measures the gen-over-gen lift.

llm-jp-3-3.7b-instruct.rationale: Rank 4. JP-specialised domestic model. Useful for JP-MT-Bench style scoring.

gemma4-e4b.rationale: Demoted from ADR-002 primary. Disk size is 9.6GB on Ollama (PLE + audio_encoder shipped together) — 4× the Qwen3.5-4B Q4 footprint and tight on 16GB RAM. Kept selectable for users who already pulled it but no longer recommended for low-memory machines.

gemma4-e2b.rationale: Same PLE bloat as e4b (7.2GB on disk despite 2B effective params). Even smaller Gemma-4 is heavier than Qwen3.5-4B Q4 (2.6GB). Kept only as legacy fallback.

qwen3.6-27b.rationale: Rank-5 ceiling reference. Too heavy for 16GB-RAM CPU local; bench via external API/host machine for upper-bound quality comparison only.
qwen3.6-27b.bench_method: Run qwen3.6-27b on a separate workstation or hosted API; capture quality scores using the same prompt_templates/2026-04-v2.json pack so we can plot a single 'quality vs latency' chart with the local 4 candidates.

qwen2.5-3b-instruct.reason: License is qwen-research, not Apache-2.0. Re-distribution requires legal review.

13b_class.reason: Too slow on 16GB CPU; common-case TTFT exceeds dictation UX budget.
